_comment: Ground access by (origin key, airport, hour band). The origin key stands in for a geocode until a geocoder exists; an origin we have not curated abstains rather than guessing, because a confidently wrong ground estimate is the failure mode this product exists to avoid. Fares carry effective dates: three of these moved inside one year.

AMS.infeasible_reason: The airport train does not run overnight.
AMS.note: NS runs a night train about hourly through Schiphol after the last regular train, so the airport is never cut off; the 2026 fare was not readable (EUR 5.20 in 2025).

MXP.infeasible_reason: The Malpensa Express does not run overnight.
MXP.note: SEA (the airport operator): Terminal 1-2 to Milano Centrale 05:09 to 22:09 every 30 minutes; the Cadorna branch's last train was not readable, so the earlier Centrale time stands. Fare unverified (malpensaexpress.it refuses automated readers).

LIS.infeasible_reason: The metro does not run overnight.
LIS.source: Metro de Lisboa / Carris: single EUR 1.90 plus the EUR 0.50 navegante card a visitor must buy; ECB reference rate of 2026-09-24 (EUR 1 = USD 1.137, GBP 1 = USD 1.322), rounded up

BCN.note: Runs 24 hours, every 5-10 minutes by day and every 20 minutes from 00:35 to 05:00 (Aerobus). The fare was not readable from Aerobus's own page, so the figure is unverified.

routes._comment: OVERRIDE LAYER, empty on purpose. Par is the all-in effective cost of a defined reference itinerary (nonstop, main cabin with a bag, baseline carrier, 31-inch pitch, from the city centre, at the time of day the market flies), and concorde-travel/par.py models it for any route on Earth from the two airports' coordinates, the market the route sits in, and the month. A row here wins over the model: put one in ONLY with a basis a human can defend - the eight rows that used to live here ($1,050 for JFK-LHR and the like) were guesses with nothing behind them, put 57% of a real search at A+, and were retired on 2026-09-20 when the model replaced them.

_checked: 2026-09-25: every transit fare and taxi figure here was checked against the operator's or regulator's own page and re-checked by a second reader. Confirmed: the New York subway, AirTrain JFK and NJ Transit fares, Madrid's airport supplement, Lisbon's metro hours, the NYC TLC JFK flat fare. Corrected: the Paris airport ticket, the Elizabeth line, Lisbon's and Madrid's metro fares, the Aerobus and Schiphol night service, the Malpensa Express's last train. Not readable (the operators refuse automated readers): the Malpensa Express and Aerobus fares, and most service hours. Rideshare fares have no published source anywhere and stay estimates.
